original: 雨は止んだばっかりだ。

en.text: The rain has just stopped.
It's just stopped raining.

original: 雨が止んでよかった。

en.text: I'm glad that the rain has stopped.
I'm glad the rain has stopped.

original: ちょうど雨も止んだし、行けるね。

en.text: The rain has just stopped. We can go.

original: 雨が止んだら行きます。

en.text: I will go if the rain stops.
